notes.title: Dear Friends! The Game Launches This Week!
notes.content: [p]We’ve poured our hearts into creating the best possible experience, but perfection is a journey. That’s why we’ll continue polishing the game [b]until August 8th[/b]! You can buy and play it starting [b]August 1st[/b]—or revisit it after updates to enjoy new content that deepens immersion and refines gameplay.[/p][p][b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]This is [b]Chapter 1 of 3[/b], released as [b]Early Access[/b]. Your purchase includes all future chapters and updates at no extra cost.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Linux & MacOS versions[/b] will be available [b]by August 8th[/b]![/p][/*][/olist]
